By contrast, an explicit six-figure fee regulation utilizes a distinct fiscal mechanism—specifically leveraging broad statutory authority to set cost-recovery and premium adjudication fees—creating a structurally tighter legal tether designed to withstand the procedural hurdles that tripped up the 2020 wage rule.
